why_parked: Two of five slots were intentionally left open to fill with live bets at SuperContest lines (CLE +5.5, CAR +1.5). Both games went final before they were filled, so the ticket cannot be completed this week.

structure.note: Risk/win as placed are for the 3 placed legs; not a complete 5-team ticket.

future_use_notes: Pattern: place the early-certain SuperContest picks first, hold slots for picks where the contest line beats the book line, fill them live at the contest number.
Fill the open slots before those games kick off; a live bet on a started game moves the price and a final game cannot be filled.
Check the book accepts adding live legs to the same ticket before relying on it; otherwise place the extra legs as a separate parlay or straight bets.
Score tickets as placed: a partial ticket pays at its placed odds, not at the full 5-team price.
